additional_info.subject: ID0468672-DC/Si-D/CZ- [Y2 / S6 313724839009] CPI not available CRM:03289000037
additional_info.body:
Hi Tomas, good morning.
I see some checks you performed but here we need to understand a couple of things:
Did you try to swap BC1 and BC2?
This is usually my go-to since we can immediately confirm if there is something wrong in the circuit or the device.
Did you perform a visual check?
I've found that sometimes there are some cables that are touching the copper bars deeper inside the charger that cause this.
Please let me know your thoughts and questions.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
